d: Bihar vidhan parishad (Bihar MLC) ke chunav natijon ke bad mahagathbandhan ke bhitar rajnitik bhuchal aa gaya hai. 2 navnirvachit nirdaliy emaelsi (banshidhar brajvasi aur rahul raj) dvara bhartiy janta parti (BJP) ko samarthan die jane ke bad ab jadyu aur mahagathbandhan kheme men khalabli mach gaee hai. kya nishkasan aur dalabdal kanun ke tahat in 2 MLC par bari prashasnik va rajnitik karravaee hone ja rahi hai? dekhie patna se yah vishesh rajnitik vishleshan riporta.
